_help: Hand-curated outside events. Add one object per event. Times are local Eastern. Use "allDay": true and a date-only "start" (YYYY-MM-DD) for all-day events. category: area | benefits | community | post. Always include the organizer's page in "url" so members can confirm details.

events.title: VA Providence Employment Resource Center Veteran Job Fair
events.location: Providence VA Medical Center, Main Building 5th Floor Classrooms, 830 Chalkstone Ave, Providence
events.description: Free job fair connecting veterans with local employers. Contact the Employment Resource Center at 401-273-7100 ext. 13491.

events.title: OktoberVets 5K (VFW Post 152)
events.location: Start: First Baptist Church, 44 Main St, North Kingstown; Finish: Town Docks, 61 Brown St, North Kingstown
events.description: 5K race through historic Wickford Village hosted by VFW Post 152, plus a .152K fun run for all ages, with a 11:00am start wave. Proceeds benefit the Gateway to Independence veteran transitional housing program and the Holiday Veteran in Need program.

events.title: Westerly Veterans Day Parade
events.location: Westerly, RI (organized by the Ocean Community Chamber of Commerce)
events.description: Check the organizer's page for the route and step-off point.

events.title: WaterFire Salute to Veterans (14th annual)
events.location: State House to WaterPlace Park, Providence
events.description: Opening ceremonies at the State House, torch procession, Veterans Resource Fair on Washington Street (3:00-10:00 p.m.), military vehicle display, memorial tributes at sunset and a Memorial Canoe Ceremony. About 150 veterans serve as torchbearers; sign-up and mobility assistance are on the event page.

events.title: Cranston Veterans Day Parade
events.location: Starts on Doric Avenue behind the Pub on Park, along Park Avenue to Pontiac Avenue, north on Rolfe Street to Rolfe Square, followed by a ceremony at the Cannon Memorial, Cranston
events.description: Annual Veterans Day parade and ceremony revived as a Cranston tradition. Time/route based on the 2025 running; check the city's page closer to the date for any changes.
